name: uploads
title: Photo and file uploads
summary: `requestMultipart` sends `{ uri, name, type }` parts through React Native's XMLHttpRequest with a long time-out — the global `expo/fetch` rejects them — plus the picker rules that keep the server from refusing the file.
when: Profile pictures, attachments, documents — any file the user picks.
claudeRules: Multipart uploads use `requestMultipart` (`src/modules/uploads/upload.ts`), never the global fetch. Keep the image picker's `quality` below 1, ask for the compatible (JPEG) representation, measure the file itself rather than the picker's size, and validate the extension as well as the type.
